Notice to complete a tax return - reference HC-3834657
Our records show you are required to complete a return for the year ending 5 April 2026. Your unique taxpayer reference is 09839 30103. Please keep it safe and quote it whenever you contact us.
A paper return has an earlier deadline than one filed online. The general filing dates for every year are printed in the box below; where this letter gives you a date, that date applies.
Your return must reach us by 22 September 2026. A return received after that date attracts an automatic penalty of £100.00 even if no tax is owed.
Any tax you owe for the year is payable by the same date. If you cannot pay in full, call us on 0300 200 0000 before the date passes.

obligations.ask: Write to us to stop completing a return

results.segment: If you no longer need to complete a return - for instance you have stopped being self-employed write to us and we will review your record.
Paper returns: 31 October following the end of the tax year. Online returns and any balancing payment: 31 January following the end of the tax year. Interest runs from the day after a payment date.
Leon Davison Assessment Officer National Revenue Assessment Office
If you write to us, quote your reference. Information about how we use your data is at the address above.
